## Cross-Company Master-Data Synchronization

Receives customer or vendor master-data changes, normalizes and matches records, resolves conflicts, synchronizes to target systems, verifies the sync, and returns a full audit report.

### All nodes (1-line each)
1. Webhook - Master Data Change – Receives customer or vendor master-data payload via POST.
2. Code - Validate & Normalize – Validates the payload and normalizes fields into a canonical model.
3. Code - Match & Deduplicate – Matches the incoming record against existing golden records using keys and fuzzy rules.
4. Wait - Pre Conflict Check – Short pause before conflict evaluation.
5. Code - Detect Conflicts – Identifies field-level conflicts between incoming data and the golden record.
6. Wait - Pre Sync – Pause before writing to target systems.
7. HTTP Request - Sync to ERP – Pushes the resolved master record to the ERP system.
8. Code - Process ERP Result – Records ERP sync outcome.
9. Wait - Pre CRM Sync – Pause before CRM synchronization.
10. HTTP Request - Sync to CRM – Pushes the resolved master record to the CRM system.
11. Code - Process CRM Result – Records CRM sync outcome.
12. Wait - Pre Verify – Pause before verification.
13. HTTP Request - Verify Sync – Confirms the record exists and matches in target systems.
14. Code - Build Sync Report – Aggregates match, conflict, sync and verification results into a final report.
15. Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the response payload for the caller.
16. Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete master-data synchronization result.

## 1. Intake, Normalize & Match

Webhook - Master Data Change – Receives customer or vendor master-data payload via POST.
Code - Validate & Normalize – Validates the payload and normalizes fields into a canonical model.
Code - Match & Deduplicate – Matches the incoming record against existing golden records using keys and fuzzy rules.

## 2. Conflict Resolution & Multi-System Sync

Wait - Pre Conflict Check – Short pause before conflict evaluation.
Code - Detect Conflicts – Identifies field-level conflicts between incoming data and the golden record.
Wait - Pre Sync – Pause before writing to target systems.
HTTP Request - Sync to ERP – Pushes the resolved master record to the ERP system.
Code - Process ERP Result – Records ERP sync outcome.
Wait - Pre CRM Sync – Pause before CRM synchronization.
HTTP Request - Sync to CRM – Pushes the resolved master record to the CRM system.
Code - Process CRM Result – Records CRM sync outcome.

## 3. Verify & Respond

Wait - Pre Verify – Pause before verification.
HTTP Request - Verify Sync – Confirms the record exists and matches in target systems.
Code - Build Sync Report – Aggregates match, conflict, sync and verification results into a final report.
Code - Finalize Response – Assembles the response payload for the caller.
Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete master-data synchronization result.
